effects.name: Progress card that ticks itself
effects.what: A small card with a list of jobs. Each row flips to done as the line is spoken. Some add a thin progress bar and a counter (REEL 36 / 70).
effects.moves: Card fades or pops in. Rows complete one at a time on the spoken word, usually as a spinner or empty box turning into a check in under 0.2 seconds.
effects.build: A card with N rows. Each row has two states (pending, done). Switch the state at the transcript time of its word. Optional: tween a bar width and a counter number across the whole hold.
effects.use_for: Any 'it did this, then this, then this' line. Shows work happening without a screen recording.

effects.name: Document that scrolls to what you are saying
effects.what: The real result document on screen, scrolling to the section being spoken about. Often with the top and bottom edges blurred so the eye lands in the middle.
effects.moves: Cuts in already on the page. A quick scroll (about 0.2 seconds) lands on the section, then a slow upward drift while you talk.
effects.build: A tall screenshot or live page inside a clipped frame. Tween its Y position to each section at the spoken time, then drift 10 to 20 pixels. Add a blur gradient mask top and bottom.
effects.use_for: Proof that the output exists. Works for a report, a scoreboard, a skill file, a long prompt.

effects.name: Point at the exact line
effects.what: On a screenshot or document, one line gets singled out: a box drawn round it, a highlighter wipe, an accent outline, or everything else dimmed.
effects.moves: The mark appears on the spoken word. A box or outline pops in under 0.2 seconds. A highlighter wipes left to right in about 0.2 to 0.4 seconds.
effects.build: An absolutely positioned box or highlight over the screenshot at the line's coordinates. Pop it, or tween its width from 0. For a spotlight, a dark overlay with a clear slot that slides.
effects.use_for: Any time the proof is on screen but the viewer would not know where to look.

effects.name: Label pill on the seam that swaps to the spoken term
effects.what: In a split layout, one small pill sits where the top panel meets the face. Its text changes to name the thing currently being shown.
effects.moves: Pops in one step. The text swaps in place on the spoken word. It stays put across cuts, which ties the scenes together.
effects.build: One fixed-position pill element. Change its text content at each transcript time. No motion on the pill itself.
effects.use_for: Naming tools or steps as you go, without a new graphic for each.

effects.name: List that stacks, new item on top
effects.what: A list builds one labelled bar at a time. Each new bar arrives at the top and pushes the others down. Can be replayed later as a callback.
effects.moves: About 0.4 seconds per bar: the new one fades in above while the stack slides down one row.
effects.build: A column of bars. For each new bar, tween the existing stack down by one row height and fade the new bar in at the top.
effects.use_for: 'It built these' lists: skills, tools, steps.

effects.name: Example window that grows and shrinks per topic
effects.what: A rounded inset showing the example video. It sits small in a corner while you talk, and grows large when the example is the point.
effects.moves: Scales and moves over about 0.4 to 0.6 seconds, or jumps in under 0.2. The content inside cuts independently.
effects.build: A wrapper around a second video. Tween its scale and position between two presets on topic changes.
effects.use_for: Teaching an edit or a technique where the viewer needs to see the example and you.

effects.name: Flash the cutout, then the composite
effects.what: For about half a second the person is shown cut out on a checkerboard, then the scene comes back with the type sitting behind them.
effects.moves: The checkerboard cross-dissolves to the room in roughly 0.2 to 0.4 seconds.
effects.build: Layer order: checkerboard, big type, cutout of the subject. Fade the checkerboard out to reveal the plate.
effects.use_for: Proving text really sits behind the head. A good beat in any video about editing.

effects.name: Caption with the key word in a second typeface
effects.what: Normal captions in a bold sans. The one word that matters switches to a coloured serif or script, sometimes with a glow, sometimes with letters sliding up one by one.
effects.moves: Words replace each other every 0.4 to 0.8 seconds. The emphasis word's letters rise about 10 pixels and fade in over 0.2 to 0.4 seconds.
effects.build: Two caption styles. Tag the emphasis word in the transcript and render it with the second style and a per-letter stagger.
effects.use_for: The keyword in a CTA, or the one word a line turns on.

effects.name: Fixed index list plus one swapping card
effects.what: A numbered list stays on screen. A single card beside it swaps to show each item, with an 'NN/17' counter. The active list row lights up.
effects.moves: The card content hard-cuts every 1 to 1.5 seconds. The highlight moves in the same frame. Nothing animates in between.
effects.build: A static list and one media slot. On each item time: swap the slot's source, move the highlight class, update the counter.
effects.use_for: Showing many things fast while keeping the viewer oriented. Suits your effects reels.
effects.closest: Phone feed (30), the HUD chapter list

effects.name: Clear the frame, then one big number
effects.what: Everything on screen frosts over and fades out. Then a single large number lands alone.
effects.moves: Frosted fade over about 0.2 to 0.4 seconds, then the number arrives and holds.
effects.build: Apply a blur and fade to the current graphics group, then show one oversized numeral.
effects.use_for: The turn from a list to the bigger promise ('and 26 more').

effects.name: Counter with a grid that fills
effects.what: A big number counts up while small blocks fill in beside it, one block per unit.
effects.moves: Card pops in at zero. Number and blocks rise together and reach the total in under a second, then hold for several seconds.
effects.build: A grid of N hidden squares. Stagger them visible while tweening the number text from 0 to N.
effects.use_for: Any 'I had N of these' line.
effects.caution: On a reel about saved reels this is his card for the same line. Use it on a different topic.

effects.name: Two columns, one side fades
effects.what: Two identical grids side by side. One dims to grey (lost). The other keeps a few blocks solid and grows a list under it (kept).
effects.moves: Left column fades in. Right column pops in. The dimming takes around a second.
effects.build: Two grids of squares. Tween one side's fill to grey. On the other, keep selected squares and append label rows.
effects.use_for: Any before and after, or you versus the tool.
effects.caution: This is the signature graphic of his doomscroll reel. Do not use it on yours.

effects.name: A real file typing itself out
effects.what: A card styled as a file shows the real contents appearing line by line.
effects.moves: Empty card fades in over about 0.2 seconds, then one line per 0.2 second step.
effects.build: A monospace block. Reveal one line at a time. Optional footer strip for a one-line claim.
effects.use_for: Showing the actual skill, prompt or config that did the work.

effects.name: Small built UI demo in place of a screen recording
effects.what: A clean, purpose-built mock of the product doing the thing: an email typing in, a scan band sweeping a page, a status card filling in.
effects.moves: Code or text lines appear in sequence over about a second. A scan band sweeps. Status rows fill one by one.
effects.build: A small HTML scene per benefit: a window frame, typed text, one sweeping element, a status list.
effects.use_for: Explaining a benefit when the real screen is ugly or slow.
effects.caution: In your 66 reel collection, designed mocks in place of real footage sat 25 points below comparable reels.

effects.name: Blur the prompt so they have to ask for it
effects.what: The screen recording shows the prompt being pasted, but the text itself is blurred.
effects.moves: A blur region sits over the pasted block for as long as it is on screen.
effects.build: A blur filter on a rectangle tracked over the prompt area of the recording.
effects.use_for: A keyword giveaway where the prompt is the prize.

effects.name: Moving ring that shows where to look
effects.what: A circle that magnifies a small area and moves across a photo to the detail being named.
effects.moves: The ring slides between targets within one or two frames.
effects.build: A circular mask over a scaled copy of the image, positioned at the target. Tween its position.
effects.use_for: Pointing out a small detail in a photo or screenshot.

effects.name: Pill whose word spins like a slot machine
effects.what: A pill reads 'Expert at' and the last word scrolls vertically through options before settling.
effects.moves: The word blurs through several values for a few frames, then lands.
effects.build: A clipped text slot. Tween a stacked list of words upward and stop on the chosen one.
effects.use_for: 'It can do X, Y, Z' in one small graphic.

effects.name: Screenshot card on a blurred copy of itself
effects.what: A screenshot sits as a card. Behind it is the same image scaled up, blurred and darkened. An accent outline draws round the card.
effects.moves: Hard cut in. The card drifts up slightly and settles. The outline pops in under 0.2 seconds.
effects.build: Two copies of the image: one full-bleed with blur and a dark overlay, one as a centred card with a border.
effects.use_for: Showing a source (a repo, a chart, an article) without a plain flat screenshot.

effects.name: Messages pile up to a 99+ badge
effects.what: Message boxes stack one on another and a notification badge jumps to 99+.
effects.moves: Boxes arrive one at a time, then a tag appears beside the badge.
effects.build: A stack of message rows added on a stagger, plus a badge whose text changes.
effects.use_for: 'Too many people asked' and similar demand proof.

effects.name: Comment box: keyword types, comment posts, reply arrives
effects.what: A mock comment field. The keyword types in with a caret, posts, and the auto-reply or file arrives. One version flips Follow to Following.
effects.moves: Keyword types over about 0.2 to 0.4 seconds. Bubbles arrive one at a time.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: The ask.

effects.name: Draw the wrong way, then strike it out
effects.what: A diagram or price card gets a red strike or X and a handwritten note.
effects.moves: The strike draws over about 0.4 seconds.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: Enemy beats.

effects.name: Hard cut between split layout and full-screen graphic
effects.what: Explanation runs in a split layout. Step headers cut to a full-screen graphic with a step chip.
effects.moves: Hard cuts, under 0.2 seconds.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: Step headers and section breaks.

effects.name: Big type behind a shrinking subject
effects.what: Words stack behind or around the person as they shrink in frame.
effects.moves: One word per 0.2 second step while the subject scales down over about a second.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: The hook.

effects.name: Before and after slider on a grade
effects.what: A line sweeps the clip while the colour grade changes, sometimes with a tone-curve panel beside it.
effects.moves: The sweep and grade change take about 0.4 seconds.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: Any look or edit claim.

effects.name: Prompt bar over the shot
effects.what: A dark prompt bar with typed text, placed over the head when a prompt is spoken.
effects.moves: Text types on.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: 'I just typed...'

effects.name: Pipeline where a spark travels and fills each node
effects.what: Nodes joined by lines. An accent spark moves along a line and the next node fills as its step is spoken.
effects.moves: Lines draw, then a spark crosses each one in a few frames.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: Explaining a workflow.

effects.name: Wall of tiles
effects.what: A grid of tiles fills the frame to show volume, then dims.
effects.moves: Tiles arrive on a diagonal stagger.
effects.build: Already built.
effects.use_for: Volume of work or volume of saves.

effects.name: Typographic keyword card for the ask
effects.what: A plain card: a script word, then the keyword in heavy type and quotes.
effects.moves: Words pop in on 0.2 second steps.
